visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors, a man with a buzz cut and a vibrant patterned shirt featuring cartoon figures laughs heartily. He is wearing a white digital watch and orange earrings. He taps his pocket, revealing an orange smartphone tucked inside. (2) Close-up on the man's hands as he pulls the bright orange smartphone out of his patterned pocket. The phone has a prominent triple-lens camera array on the back. The man holds it up, smiling with squinted eyes. (3) A woman with long brown hair and glasses stands beside the man in a sun-drenched garden. They both look directly at the camera, gesturing with their hands as they speak. Large green palm fronds and a white building are visible in the background. (4) A demonstration of the camera's zoom feature begins. A woman is seen standing far away in a garden near a white house. The shot cuts to a sharp close-up of her face, highlighting the 8x zoom capability. (5) On the roof of the white house, the man lies down on terracotta tiles. A phone interface is shown on screen, zooming in on his face. (6) The man stands against a textured white wall, holding a small white piece of paper with a handwritten number '8' on it. (7) An indoor scene shows a phone screen displaying a family group selfie. Multiple children in red shirts and a woman are seen on the yellow sofa, laughing and making faces. (8) A dual-capture mode is demonstrated. The main frame shows a sunny outdoor lawn, while a small circular inset window shows the woman's face as she narrates the recording. (9) The woman stands in a garden, and the dual-screen mode shows the man performing on the roof in the smaller inset window. (10) The woman and a small child are shown in a vertical split-screen layout indoors, engaging in a dialogue. (11) Back outdoors, the man shows a brown textured protective case. He snaps it onto the orange phone, smiles at the camera, waves goodbye, and walks away into a gray-walled area.
